integrity_statement: Exact integral primal and integer-scaled rational dual certificates are included with a stand-alone standard-library verification program. No independent scientific audit has been conducted.
limitations: The sharp norm is for the simplicial l1 area of real or integral 2-chains bounding three times a shortest essential simple 4-cycle in the 7-point matching complex. It is not a metric disc-area theorem, a uniform-n bound, or a classification of all 2-chain minimizers.
title: A sharp twenty-eight-triangle torsion filling in the seven-point matching complex
